newsitem.title: USA: RPM says sells resin plant to Valspar unit.
newsitem.headline: RPM says sells resin plant to Valspar unit.

text.p: RPM Inc said Monday its Rust-Oleum Corp subsidiary sold its resin facility to Engineered Polymer Solutions Inc, a subsidiary of Valspar Corp.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.
The resin facility is located in Hagerstown, Md.

RPM said Engineered Polymer, which intends to expand the facility's resin manufacturing capacity in order to serve its East Coast customers, will continue to supply resins to Rust-Oleum under terms of the sale agreement.
Rust-Oleum Corp will continue to own and operate its paint manufacturing plant located next to the Maryland resin facility.
RPM said this sale continues its efforts to divest itself of non-core product lines and businesses. It expects to complete more divestitures throughout the balance of the 1997 calendar year, it said.
